source: due2-native: one logical constraint with both odrl:and and odrl:or (external review R07, #117)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: a logical constraint has exactly one operand property (IM 2.5.2). Read as a conjunction of its two operands, ex:window is ex:fromStart and ex:untilEnd; read as a disjunction, ex:fromStart or ex:untilEnd. A report published on 2027-03-01 satisfies ex:fromStart only, so the two readings give F and T. clingo-i declined it before this case; tools/check_corpus.py admitted it.

expected_rejection.why: ex:window has both odrl:and and odrl:or, and a logical constraint has one operand property (IM 2.5.2, due2-profiles.md §5). W1 rejects the policy with MalformedConstraint, in stage 2.
